> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**

They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Wildlife biologist (`emst:wildlife/ROL-46NJRQF`, P2); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.3.0, rule state-class-view@0.2.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped at skos:closeMatch or stronger in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Capture, handle and mark wildlife and fish humanely and safely — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Adjudicate automated species detections using field-formed identification expertise — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess and monitor biodiversity across species and habitats — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Implement international wildlife and fisheries conservation agreements — senior L2, lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
